page_title: LEC 2-1 FRO | Lecce v Frosinone 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) duly receives a yellow card.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Frosinone is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+1' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Roberto Piccoli is replaced by Hamza Rafia (Lecce).
90+1' Substitution. Giorgi Kvernadze (Frosinone) has come on for Francesco Gelli.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Enzo Barrenechea trots off the pitch and is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Frosinone).
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

89' 2 - 1 Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner.

88' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches onto a short pass from Roberto Piccoli inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
85' It looks like Marin Pongracic (Lecce) saw red with that tackle. Luca Zufferli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
83' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) replacing Remi Oudin.
82' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
79' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Arijon Ibrahimovic will be replaced by Abdou Harroui (Frosinone).
76' Here is a change. Gabriel Strefezza is going off and Roberto D'Aversa gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
76' A substitution has been made. Alexis Blin is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
75' The ball goes out for a corner. Frosinone can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Luca Zufferli shows a yellow card to Alexis Blin (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
71' Lameck Banda (Lecce) creates a good chance for himself and fires in a powerful close-range shot, but his effort ricochets off the right post.
69' Frosinone seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
66' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Lecce have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Matias Soule (Frosinone) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the left of the target.
60' None of the Lecce players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.

56' What a save from Wladimiro Falcone! Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
53' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
51' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
50' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Referee Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Lameck Banda (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45+5' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+5' Lameck Banda (Lecce) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

45+3' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) runs onto a ball from Matias Soule and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Flag goes up against Lameck Banda (Lecce) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

42' CHANCE! Remi Oudin finds Lameck Banda (Lecce) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just over the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
39' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Frosinone will have a goal kick.
38' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) receives a yellow card.
36' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Wladimiro Falcone.
33' Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
32' The Frosinone players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
31' There's a break in play and referee Luca Zufferli must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Frosinone using VAR. This could be interesting!
30' PENALTY APPEAL by Frosinone, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
30' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
29' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. Good work from Frosinone as they win a corner.
28' Marco Brescianini (Frosinone) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
27' Pol Lirola (Frosinone) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

25' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wladimiro Falcone makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
24' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
24' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
23' The Frosinone players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
19' NO PENALTY! Referee Luca Zufferli has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Frosinone players are incensed.
18' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Frosinone, he's going to review using VAR.

17' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Frosinone! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
16' Frosinone have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

16' That's unlucky! Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Now Frosinone have a corner.
15' The ball is cleared after Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
15' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ilario Monterisi is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Lameck Banda sets up Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
10' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Frosinone.
6' Frosinone concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
5' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
4' An attempted cross from Pol Lirola (Frosinone) is cleared.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Zufferli.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
